Q9029.reason: Sterile water is hypotonic and can be absorbed through the bladder wall, causing electrolyte disturbance, which is why saline is used.

Q9030.reason: The son's rights had not vested, since he had not learned of the contract, relied on it or assented, so the original parties could still modify the payee.

Q9031.reason: Under UCC 2-210 and 9-406, a general anti-assignment clause does not bar assigning the right to receive payment.
